serviceCapacity.source: flexcar.service_capacities for allocatedMin, each bucket's own table (capacity_bookings source_type='Order', maintenance_bookings, unassigned_services) for bookedMin, service_capacities reserved as ledgerBookedMin
serviceCapacity.note: allocatedMin is modelled labour minutes set aside per bucket per day; bookedMin is the authoritative load from that bucket's own table; ledgerBookedMin is the service_capacities reserved figure, kept only so its intermittent lag stays visible and never used as the booked side; onFlexService.bookedMin is whole-job estimated minutes while its ledgerBookedMin is remaining minutes, so the two are not expected to agree even when the ledger is healthy; null means no service_capacities row for that site/day, not zero capacity.

orderCapacity.note: Static per-lot admin settings, not a per-day series: the same ceiling applies to every day of the window until someone edits the lot. daily_order_capacity is the admin UI's 'Daily Pickup & Swap Capacity', not an all-order ceiling. null means not configured, which is not the same as a ceiling of zero.
